apps.name: INFORMANT
apps.description: Local workspace for researching YouTube videos, articles, and Reddit posts. Organize work into projects, pull in URLs, and keep notes, bookmarks, transcripts, comments, and AI analysis on each item. Includes a single floating YouTube player, project-wide chat/actions, export/import, and Android share-target import. No YouTube account login required - API keys go in Settings.
apps.changelog:
- Fix hang on install by shipping a proper release-signed APK (not debug)
- Version 1.0.2 (versionCode 3)

apps.name: Rush
apps.description: Unofficial Rush companion app with the full discography, album details, lyrics, band history, studio timeline, search, and random song/video picks. Includes My Collection for favorites, star ratings, saved lyric excerpts, notes, custom YouTube links, and library import/export. Content is bundled on-device from rush.com sources.
apps.changelog:
- Initial RykerSoft hub release
- Discography, lyrics, band pages, timeline, search, random song/video
- My Collection with favorites, ratings, excerpts, and library import/export
